Package org.forgerock.openam.session.service.access

Class SessionQueryFilterRealm

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.forgerock.openam.session.service.access.SessionQueryFilterRealm
  • public final class SessionQueryFilterRealm
extends Object
    Reads the realm a session CREST query filter asks for, so that the realm can be authorized against the caller before the query is run against the CTS.

    The supported filter shapes are the ones supported by org.forgerock.openam.session.service.access.persistence.SessionQueryFilterVisitor, i.e. and of equals comparisons. Any other filter type is rejected with an UnsupportedOperationException by the visitor this class is based on, exactly as it would be rejected when the filter is later translated into a CTS query.

    • Method Detail

      • extract

        public static String extract​(CrestQuery crestQuery)
        Returns the realm named in the query filter of the provided CREST query.
        Parameters:
        crestQuery - The CREST query to inspect. May be null.
        Returns:
        The realm named in the query filter, or null if the query does not carry a filter, or the filter does not name a realm.
        Throws:
        IllegalArgumentException - If the filter names more than one realm, since in that case the realm the query would run against cannot be authorized, or if the realm contains a .. path segment, since such a realm is authorized as the path it is written as, while it may name another realm once it is resolved.
